claim: local.ifname=lo keeps the multicast send off the LAN

strong_20s.probe: r99b confinement: 20 s windows, enp7s0 tx_packets+tx_bytes

synthetic_lo_3000pkts.note: SO_BINDTODEVICE(lo)+IP_MULTICAST_IF(127.0.0.1); delta is BELOW the matched idle rate

strong_20s.interpretation: 19588 multicast RTP packets were emitted; the enp7s0 window that contains them is below both bracketing idle windows (9914 vs 12322/11003 packets and 7.28 vs 9.31/9.39 MB). If the stream had egressed, +19588 packets / +4.0 MB would appear. The local copy is still delivered to sockets joined on ANY interface of this host (loopback of the lo-bound send), which is why an enp7s0-joined receiver sees the stream with the host's own LAN address as peer.

quiet.note: the enp7s0-joined receiver also sees the local loopback copy of a lo-bound send (peer = this host's LAN address); egress is judged by the tx counter
